changes.title: Hats b
items: Five more hats to pick in your room's Hat box
Bramble: wild creatures within 30 m of it are slowed
Mine: put it down and it stuns wild creatures within 15 m
Lullaby: put it down and wild creatures nearby fall asleep; a 💌 wakes one up
Cyclone: a whirlwind sweeps creatures round it, lifts them up and flings them away
Nursing: your own creatures near it heal

changes.title: Chart biomes lakes
items: The sea chart paints each island like a real map: green lowlands, uplands, rock and peaks, darker forests, in its biome's colours (cold, hot, rocky, jungle and the rest)
Lakes on the sea chart's islands, pale water lying in the hills
The sea chart's island sigils grow more detailed as you zoom in: carved bands, then a solid carved emblem

changes.title: Hats a
items: Five new hats to pick in your room's Hat box
Harvest: put it down and six berries grow round it
Dowsing: put it down and a pointer leads you to the nearest relic for a minute
Sentry: put it down and it throws 💌s at wild creatures nearby
Slingshot: 💌s you throw past it circle it, then fly off at a creature further away
Gathering: put it down, then pick it up again, and every sigil you placed within 100 m comes back to you
